description: This file contains shell script functions related to upgrading firmware on specific hardware boards, with a focus on dual partition boot configurations for embedded devices.

methods.name: set_boot_part
methods.description: Sets the boot parameters for dual-boot partitions based on board type and partition number, writing environment variables and boot commands.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_plasmacloud
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by selecting inactive firmware partition, updating files, and configuring boot environment for plasmacloud boards.
